title: OHCHR documents mass arrests in the West Bank
affected_population: Palestinians in the occupied West Bank
summary: OHCHR documented a surge in arrests of Palestinians after 7 October.
claim: OHCHR documented mass arrests by Israeli security forces across the occupied West Bank, including East Jerusalem, during the reporting period.
legal_characterization: Evidence and accounts documented by OHCHR; not a judicial finding.
source_organization: Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights
source_title: The human rights situation in the occupied West Bank including East Jerusalem, 7 October – 20 November 2023
verification_notes: Verified against the cited thematic section. Where the source reports allegations, the claim retains that qualification rather than converting them into findings.
